'''Rayleigh test''' can refer to:
* a test for periodicity in irregularly sampled data,<ref>[http://adsabs.harvard.edu/full/1994MNRAS.268..709B Confidence Intervals from the Rayleigh Test]</ref>
* a derivation of the above to test for non-uniformity (as unimodal clustering) of a set of points on a circle (e.g. compass directions),<ref>[http://www.mathworks.com/matlabcentral/fileexchange/10676-circular-statistics-toolbox--directional-statistics-/content//circ_rtest.m MATLAB code for circ_rtest function].</ref> sometimes known as the Rayleigh ''z''&nbsp;test.<ref>[http://webspace.ship.edu/pgmarr/Geo441/Lectures/Lec%2016%20-%20Directional%20Statistics.pdf Lecture on directional statistics].</ref>
